newsitem.title: JAPAN: All Tokyo corn futures end higher, July limit-up.
newsitem.headline: All Tokyo corn futures end higher, July limit-up.

text.p: All Tokyo corn futures closed sharply higher on Thursday, reflecting price rallies on the Chicago market overnight and speculative buying from some individual investors, traders said.
July futures were up by the daily 500 yen limit at the close, and the benchmark January 1998 contract ended up 420 yen at 15,980 yen per tonne. The day's volume was 106,024 lots.

Active buying orders emerged from the opening as bullish sentiment remained from Wednesday's trade, traders said. "Some individual investors actively built long positions in distant months," a brokerage house trader said.
The spot March contract on the CBOT Project A trading system was being traded at $2.72-1/2 per bushel at 0840 GMT, unchanged from Wednesday's close.
The spot March of the CBOT soybean futures on the overnight trading system was at $7.40 per bushel at 0840 GMT, up from $7.39-1/2 at Wednesday's close.
